Most notably, the initial segments of the poem (§0.2–2.4) exhibit a near-verbatim parallel (similarity score 0.96) with an earlier homonymous poem, the *Saraṇagamaniyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 361) [DharmaNexus].
